notes: Conditional win rates are observational rather than causal values.
Board-swing z-scores are computed within card type; cards explicitly marked as delayed utility are not graded on immediate swing.
Playability flags compare each card with the median of its rules family (Force, Bond, Name, Narrative, or Stratagem), so normal structural gating is not mistaken for an individual card defect.
Flags identify cases for inspection; they are not automatic nerf/buff instructions.
Every canonical card remains in the report. Cards with no observed self-play exposure are labelled Unobserved rather than healthy.
Counterfactual and MCCFR reports are merged when explicitly run; neither is required for routine health analysis.

limitations: This report scores only unconditional printed Strength.
Position, timing, hand economy, movement, persistence, Narratives, Stratagems, and dynamic effects require game simulation.
Static outliers are diagnostics, not automatic balance failures.

methodology.card_effect: base outcome - same legal deck context with the focal card replaced by its matched baseline
methodology.censoring: A paired card sample is excluded from the effect estimate if either matched condition reaches the action horizon. Censored matches and pairs remain reported explicitly.
methodology.pair_interaction: Not evaluated in full-pool sweep; select a compatible card subset to evaluate interactions.
methodology.triple_interaction: Not evaluated in full-pool sweep; select a compatible card subset to evaluate interactions.
methodology.ci95: paired percentile bootstrap over decisive per-card matched samples; bounded Hoeffding interval when observed contrasts are constant
methodology.interpretation: Each card is tested in legal contexts containing that card. Effects are policy- and context-distribution-specific, not universal equilibrium values.

methodology.selection: Targets are nominated by broad heuristic causal magnitude, severity, and whether the paired interval excludes zero.
methodology.pairing: Uses a subset of the exact broad experiment deck contexts, game seeds, focal seats, and intervention definitions.
methodology.censoring: A targeted paired contrast is estimated only when every required intervention condition finishes before the action horizon. Censored conditions remain reported explicitly.
methodology.epistemic_fairness: The opponent receives the same uniform hypothesis prior over all factorial focal-deck variants in every intervention condition; it is never told which condition is active.
methodology.other_deck_prior: The focal player's belief over the opponent deck uses the general legal card-pool prior, not simulator truth.
methodology.interpretation: Confirmed means the online-MCCFR interval excludes zero in the same direction as the broad heuristic signal. Reversed means it excludes zero in the opposite direction. Intervals are unadjusted for target selection and multiple comparisons; reused contexts are not an independent replication.

structural_play.purpose: High-volume structural, pacing, exposure and matchup screening; not a strong-play claim.

broad_card_screen.purpose: Paired real-card versus neutral-baseline screening under a fixed cheap policy.

strategic_confirmation.purpose: Targeted re-solving of suspicious paired card signals using the exact same contexts and interventions.

run_summary.interpretation: Evidence is hierarchical. Heuristic self-play describes broad structure and exposure. Heuristic paired replacements are a screen for candidate card effects. A suspicious card is only treated as strategically confirmed when targeted online-MCCFR validation agrees. Censored games and paired samples remain structural evidence but are excluded from outcome estimates.

definitions.lifecycle_action: Formation timing counts Battle decision actions, including effect choices, but excludes mandatory draw-cleanup discards.
definitions.formation_identity: A formation lifecycle is anchored to its Force. Explicit Maneuvers and moves preserve that identity; reconciliation then matches unchanged positions, component signatures, and Force multisets without creating new lifecycles for movement. If a simultaneous mass move leaves fully identical formations indistinguishable, identity is matched deterministically in stable board order while aggregate creation/removal counts are preserved.
definitions.battle_end_formation_state: Complete and partial formation counts at Battle end use the final pre-resolution Battle state, before cleanup removes the board.
definitions.partial_formation: A board position with a Force that is not yet both Bonded and Named.
definitions.active_front: A Front containing at least one Force for either player.
definitions.contested_front: A Front containing at least one Force for both players.
definitions.front_control_change: One Front's controller changes between consecutive operation decisions.
definitions.durable_lead: Earliest recorded decision state after which the same player's non-zero total-Strength lead keeps the same sign through every later recorded state. The Long War has no overall Battle winner, so this is a persistence measure, not an outcome or winner claim.
definitions.first_pass_result: There is no overall Battle winner. First-pass outcome groups therefore use final Front balance: Fronts won minus Fronts lost by the first passer.
definitions.constraint_rule_source: A necessity-classed card or card with an explicit constraint rule block is present in play. This does not mean its restriction is implemented or active.
definitions.constraint_active: Requires an explicit engine-exposed active constraint marker. Telemetry does not reconstruct hypothetical legality from card text.
definitions.card_draw_to_play: Physical card copies are not engine-identified, so duplicate copies are paired draw-to-play in FIFO order for timing aggregates.
definitions.drawn_after_reshuffle: A card copy was in that player's discard pile when it was reshuffled, then a matching copy was subsequently drawn. Duplicate copies are matched by count.
definitions.held_across_battle_boundary: Hand survival across a Battle boundary is a multiset intersection by card id; identical duplicate copies are not physically distinguishable.
definitions.discarded_without_play: A card moved from hand into discard without being the card action just played. Cards leaving the battlefield during Battle cleanup do not count.
definitions.unplayed_at_match_end: Copies still in hand when the match ends. Cards remaining unseen in the deck are not counted.
definitions.battle_index: Battle 1, 2 and 3 are separate; all later Battles aggregate into 4+.
definitions.match_length: Battle reach uses the final Battle number observed in each match. Censored matches count as having reached their current Battle but not as having resolved it.
definitions.command_gained_or_refunded: Command gained after an operation beyond its actual paid cost. Between-Battle recovery is excluded and remains visible in the Battle-indexed trajectory.
definitions.eventual_completion_rate_for_forces_depl: Among Force lifecycles created in that Battle number, the share that eventually become complete Force-Bond-Name formations later in the match.
definitions.forced_maneuver: A decision whose complete legal action set contains exactly one action, and that action is Maneuver.
